title: Spreadsheet Cell Art — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Filter the group
scenes.purpose: Show the filter effect first: column B's filter removes the zero-link rows so only the connected group remains.
visuals: Frozen column headers A–F and row numbers
Table Part/Links with Idea 1, Sketch 3, Prototype 6, Team 10, Noise 0, Doubt 0
D3 shows the stale value 1 from =B2
B header filter button opens a checklist; the 0 value is unticked
Noise and Doubt rows collapse; rows 8+ slide up; hidden-row marker appears

beats.development: Unfiltered table, formula bar =B2 and stale result 1 are readable.
Filter button activates, checklist drops in and the 0 entry is unticked, then the menu closes.
Rows 6–7 collapse, lower rows close the gap, and the filtered group A2:B5 is highlighted.

scenes.title: Trace the inputs
scenes.purpose: Trace the formula's input cells after the filter.
visuals: Formula bar types =SUM(B2:B5) with the reference in the active colour
Active border draws around B2:B5 and settles into a dashed range border
Connector line draws from the range to D3 (no arrowhead)

beats.development: Formula =SUM(B2:B5) is typed into the formula bar for D3.
Range border completes around B2:B5, source cells pulse, connector reaches D3.

scenes.title: Corrected value in place
scenes.purpose: Reveal the corrected result in D3 and hold group, formula and result together.
visuals: D3 fills with the active colour; value counts 1 → 20 and shows 20 ✓

beats.development: D3 turns active and counts up to 20 ✓; the was/now note appears.
Settled hold: filtered group, =SUM(B2:B5), dashed range, connector and 20 ✓ visible together.

findings: Filter precedes trace, trace precedes result, as the style requires.
All motion settles by 2.5 s, before the 2.7 s limit.
justifiedHolds: 0–0.22 s: lets the viewer read the unfiltered table and the stale value.
2.5–3.0 s: explanatory hold with group, formula and result visible together.

notes: Demonstrated recipe: the style's characteristic action (filter one group, trace the formula's inputs, reveal the corrected value in place). STYLE.json has no tech.preview_recipes entry and there is no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json, so no other recipe or source-frame evidence was available.
